name: Brennan Center for Justice
summary: A nonpartisan law and policy institute in New York and Washington, founded in 1995 and named after Justice William J. Brennan Jr., and affiliated with NYU School of Law. It researches, litigates and campaigns for voting rights and fair elections, checks on presidential power, fair courts and an end to mass incarceration, with a 501(c)(4) affiliate, the Brennan Center Strategic Fund, for lobbying. In the year to June 2025 it spent $57.6 million.

spending.source: https://www.brennancenter.org/sites/default/files/2026-01/audited-financial-statements-fiscal-year-2025.pdf (audited consolidated statement of functional expenses, year ended June 30 2025, p. 5: program services $41,606,979 of $57,559,908 total expenses, before $2,888,342 of donated legal services (note 11), which are donors' resources)
